name: bespok3d-jinni-klipper-linux
title: Klipper on Linux jinni
description: The jinni for a Klipper printer whose host is a Debian style Linux box with systemd (MainsailOS, Fluidd, a KIAUH install on a Raspberry Pi class board): the printer side process that reads this host's layout, board and service facts and actuates the daemon's install operations on it. It reads where Klipper and Moonraker actually live from the host's own systemd environment files rather than assuming one layout. Bundles the shared klipper jinni runtime it extends, so a printer needs only this one package. It is not independently startable: the daemon owns its lifecycle and picks up a new jinni on the restart its own install op already performs.
tagline: The printer side process that gives the daemon Klipper on Linux device knowledge.
